goal: Complete the software development lifecycle for a task management application, ensuring all mandatory deliverables are produced and the codebase is functional and deployable
assumptions: Server entry points (app.ts, server.ts) will be created as specified in the critique
Validation file naming conventions will be resolved to match the architecture document (camelCase or updated docs)
Route files will be integrated to connect controllers to the Express application
All tests will be configured and executed successfully with coverage meeting requirements

steps.action: Execute "需求分析" — agents: pm, user
Execute "方案设计" — agents: developer, designer

Execute revised "编码实现" to address all critique issues. Must: 1) Create `docs/dev-notes.md` and `flows/implement/output/summary.md`. 2) Implement all P0 features (auth, CRUD, filtering, status, UI). 3) Ensure TypeScript compilation. 4) Implement SQLite database layer and complete REST API backend. 5) Structure source code in `src/` per architecture.
Execute testing verification including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure functionality and quality

Execute comprehensive testing with test creation, execution, and reporting - REDO: Create tests/ directory with Vitest test files for core functionalities (auth, task CRUD, validation, API endpoints). Run 'pnpm test' and verify coverage ≥70%. Generate docs/test-report.md with test cases, pass rate, and coverage. Create flows/testing/output/summary.md with execution summary. Address any P0 defects found.
Create tests/ directory with comprehensive Vitest test files covering authentication, task CRUD operations, validation logic, and API endpoints for TaskFlow application

Implement the core server application code in `server/src/`. This includes creating `app.ts` (Express app setup), `server.ts` (entry point), and the necessary directories and files for `controllers/`, `services/`, `routes/`, `middleware/`, and `models/` based on `docs/architecture.md`.

Address the critique of `flows/implement/create-core-server-code`. 1. Create `server/src/app.ts` containing Express instance, middleware (CORS, Morgan, JSON parser), route integration, and error handling. 2. Create `server/src/server.ts` as the entry point, importing the app, reading the port from env, and starting the HTTP server. 3. Ensure `server/src/config/cors.ts` exists and is correctly implemented. 4. Verify and, if necessary, rename files to use camelCase (e.g., `authController.ts`, `authMiddleware.ts`) to align with `docs/architecture.md`, or update the documentation to reflect kebab-case if preferred. 5. Confirm the `deleteTask` HTTP status code (200 vs 204) matches the design intent in `docs/architecture.md` section 5.2.5 and adjust if needed.

Create server/src/app.ts with Express instance, CORS, Morgan, JSON parser, route integration, and error handling. Create server/src/server.ts as entry point. Ensure server/src/config/cors.ts exists. Verify and rename validation files to camelCase or update architecture doc. Confirm deleteTask HTTP status code (200 vs 204) matches design intent.
Create server/vitest.config.ts (e.g., environment: 'node') and add test scripts ("test": "vitest run", "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage") to server/package.json.

Create comprehensive Vitest test files in server/src/tests/ covering authentication, task CRUD, validation logic, and API endpoints as per docs/architecture.md. Files: auth.test.ts, task.test.ts, validation.test.ts, api.test.ts.
Execute 'pnpm test' command within the server/ directory, verify test coverage meets ≥70% requirement, and ensure all test cases pass.
Generate docs/test-report.md with test cases, pass rate, and coverage metrics, and create flows/testing/output/summary.md with testing execution summary.
Address any P0 defects discovered during testing and re-run affected tests to ensure fixes work.
Execute deployment to production environment, ensuring the application is deployable and operational.
